text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: One round trip sets phase + loss; couplers t/κ build every response. P4 uses illustrative t, A — not book data.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Field coefficients t, κ live at couplers; power only as |t|², |κ|² on the budget bar · signs: e^-iφ (4.22) vs e^+iφ (4.24/4.25).

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Takeaway: one round trip (Lrt, φrt, A) plus coupler fields t/κ give every ring response; |κ|²+|t|²=1 closes the budget (MATLAB 6.4).
